Pastrami on white with mayo.d: Steamed until glossy, piled high on soft white bread with mayonnaise, iceberg and tomato.
Pastrami on white with mayo.note: Yes, we make it. Max the counterman winces.

Alvy's potato knishes.d: Flaky pastry around Idahos mashed with slow fried onion, egg washed and baked golden.
Alvy's potato knishes.note: Same recipe we baked under the coaster.

Lobster bites.d: Sweet meat folded with mayonnaise, lemon, celery and chives on toasted, buttered brioche. By the dozen.

New York cheesecake.d: Cream cheese, sour cream and lemon zest on a buttery crumb crust, baked slow in a water bath.
New York cheesecake.note: Baked every morning. Never leaves Manhattan.

Alvy's LA cucumber mint cooler.d: Cucumber, lime, mint and honey blended and strained, poured over ice and topped with seltzer.
Alvy's LA cucumber mint cooler.note: Big in Los Angeles, we hear.
